# Onboarding fixtures

Synthetic pages for the automatic onboarding tests (issue #99). "Cedar Tech" and
`cedartech.example` are invented; no real shop, page or offer was copied or fetched.
`scout-book.html` is a variant page (two SKUs with different price and stock) and
`trail-book.html` a single-product page. Both state the shop's name and country in
schema.org data, as the onboarding identity check requires, and both carry injected
instructions that must stay inert page data.
